    valid = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)

    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    is_non_empty = valid & ~is_empty
    
    if np.any(is_non_empty):
        scores[is_non_empty] = np.exp(-remaining[is_non_empty])
        
    if np.any(is_empty):

        penalty = 0.5 * num_active
        empty_indices = np.where(is_empty)[0]
        scores[empty_indices[0]] = max(0.0, 0.8 - penalty) * (1.0 - item / max_cap)
        
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    is_non_empty = valid & ~is_empty
    
    if np.any(is_non_empty):
        used_ratio = (max_cap - remaining[is_non_empty]) / max_cap
        scores[is_non_empty] = used_ratio * (1.0 - remaining[is_non_empty] / max_cap)
        
    if np.any(is_empty):
        active_bins = np.sum(bins < max_cap)
        empty_indices = np.where(is_empty)[0]
        base_open_score = 0.5 / (1.0 + 0.1 * active_bins)
        scores[empty_indices[0]] = base_open_score * (item / max_cap)
        
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    is_non_empty = valid & ~is_empty
    
    if np.any(is_non_empty):
        scores[is_non_empty] = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.power(remaining[is_non_empty], 2.0))
        
    if np.any(is_empty):
        num_active = np.sum(bins < max_cap)
        penalty = 0.2 * num_active
        empty_indices = np.where(is_empty)[0]
        scores[empty_indices[0]] = max(0.0, 1.0 - penalty) / (1.0 + item)
        
    return scores
